subject: Evidence handoff and PO intake — vendor gating process
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Tom Wyatt <t.wyatt@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence handoff and PO intake — vendor gating process

Tom —

Thanks again for confirming Redwood on the shortlist. Before Legal can send the final PO template and Procurement can issue a purchase order, Elara’s procurement team indicated you need our compliance bundle (SOC 2 Type II, ISO certificate, and pen test attestation). I want to make this as frictionless as possible.

Quick proposal for the next 48 hours:
- We’ll provide a single zipped evidence package with the three items below and a short README that maps each doc to Elara’s questionnaire sections.
- Procurement can accept the evidence package and issue a PO; if you need additional attestation (e.g., scope details), we’ll add a signed cover letter within one business day.

Action items for Elara: please confirm the recipient for DocuSign (if you prefer PO through DocuSign) and whether you need an export control clause or additional DPA language attached to the PO.

I’m attaching the evidence manifest to this first note; Marcus will follow up with the full files in a secure Drive link.

Attachment: Evidence_Manifest_RDW-ELARA-2027.txt (stub)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0213

---
[Attachment stubs referenced: SOC2_Type2_Redwood_2026.pdf, ISO27001_Cert_Redwood_2025.pdf, PenTest_Attestation_2026.txt]

From: Tom Wyatt <t.wyatt@elarahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Elara Health Procurement <procurement@elarahealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence handoff and PO intake — vendor gating process

Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear plan. Procurement confirmed they need: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where necessary), ISO 27001 certificate, and a short pen-test attestation that lists the scope and test date. DocuSign is preferred for the PO; I will be the signer unless we request legal review.

Two clarifications:
1) Can you indicate whether the SOC2 report covers the API endpoints we’ll use (inbound inference calls, embeddings)?
2) Is the pen-test attestation sufficient in place of a full penetration test report? If not, we’ll flag specifics.

If you can drop the Drive link and the README by EOD PT, procurement will start the PO intake.

—Tom
Tom Wyatt
Sourcing Manager, Elara Health
t.wyatt@elarahealth.com

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Wyatt <t.wyatt@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Evidence handoff and PO intake — vendor gating process

Tom — attaching the secure Drive bundle link below. Per Kim’s note, I included a short README that maps each file to the typical procurement checklist items you mentioned (SOC2 scope, ISO validity dates, pen-test scope & date).

Drive link (secure, view-only): https://drive.redwood.com/s/ELARA-evidence/rdw-2027-evidence-pkg

Manifest (summary):
- SOC2_Type2_Redwood_2026.pdf — redacted client identifiers; scope includes API endpoints for inference and data handling (section 3.2).
- ISO27001_Cert_Redwood_2025.pdf — certificate valid through 2028-03-15.
- PenTest_Attestation_2026.txt — attestation describing scope (external network + public API surface), performed 2026-10-07; full report under NDA (we can provide if required).

If procurement needs the full pen-test report, we’ll route via our security team and ask for Elara’s signed NDA; otherwise the attestation is standard for PO gating.

Let us know which path you prefer and we’ll expedite.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachment: README_RDW-EVIDENCE-ELARA.md (inline in Drive)

From: Elara Health Procurement <procurement@elarahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wyatt <t.wyatt@elarahealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence handoff and PO intake — vendor gating process

Marcus / Kimberly —

Thanks for the prompt bundle. Procurement reviewed the README and confirmed the documents meet the initial gating criteria. Two outstanding asks:
- Please confirm SOC2 report includes the inference API scope (Tom noted section 3.2; procurement needs a one-line confirmation we can place on the PO record).
- We need a signed short cover letter from Redwood confirming the evidence package is current as of today (2027-04-19) and that the pen-test attestation is official. That cover letter can be simple and signed by an authorized Redwood representative.

If you can provide those two items by EOD PT, procurement will open the PO intake and aim to route the PO for review next week. DocuSign is preferred.

Procurement Team
Elara Health
procurement@elarahealth.com

---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elara Health Procurement <procurement@elarahealth.com>, Tom Wyatt <t.wyatt@elarahealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence handoff and PO intake — vendor gating process

Hi Tom / Procurement —

Confirming: the SOC 2 Type II report included in the Drive bundle covers Redwood’s hosted inference API endpoints (see page 12, section 3.2 — "Inference API: request/response handling, authentication, KV cache retention policy").

Attached is a short cover letter (signed PDF) that confirms the evidence package is current as of 2027-04-20 and that the pen-test attestation reflects testing performed on 2026-10-07. If the procurement team needs the full penetration testing report, we can provide it under a mutual NDA; please advise.

Attachment: RDW-Evidence-CoverLetter_20270420.pdf (signed, 23KB)

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
